name: lexicon
description: A custom PHP MVC blogging platform.
author: webdevartisan

scripts.postinstall: npm run copy:tinymce && npm run copy:alpine
scripts.copy:alpine: shx mkdir -p public/vendor/alpine && shx cp node_modules/@alpinejs/csp/dist/cdn.min.js public/vendor/alpine/alpine.min.js && shx cp node_modules/@alpinejs/focus/dist/cdn.min.js public/vendor/alpine/focus.min.js
scripts.copy:journey-map: shx mkdir -p modules/journey-map/assets/vendor && shx cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-csp.js node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-csp-worker.js node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css node_modules/pmtiles/dist/pmtiles.js node_modules/@protomaps/basemaps/dist/basemaps.js modules/journey-map/assets/vendor && shx cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/LICENSE.txt modules/journey-map/assets/vendor/maplibre-LICENSE.txt
